facts.text: I review smart home gadgets, and as I do each year, I’ve gathered the best deals on Amazon devices available right now, live even a few days before the official kickoff of October Prime Day on Oct.
From Ring to Blink and Echo devices to Fire tablets, you can save up to 77% with early deals right now.
Here are our favorite deals across categories now.
If you aren’t a Prime member but want to shop the sale, here’s how to join with a free trial , and ways you might qualify for a big discount (including 6 months free if you’re aged 18-24 ).
Amazon holds a Prime Big Deal Days sales event every October.
As the largest Echo Show, the 21 model is a smart display and Fire TV in one.
The large 21-inch screen is big enough to display all your widgets in one place, like your calendar, shopping list, weather, and more.
Why you can trust ZDNET: ZDNET independently tests and researches products to bring you our best recommendations and advice.
When you buy through our links, we may earn a commission.

Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days sale doesn’t officially start until October 6th, but the deals have already started pouring in.
